audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 contradict the packet chart, our own whys[] and the already-applied mirror. Rows 1 and 2 read Volibear while whys[1]/whys[2] call them even; rows 5 and 6 read Volibear/Skill while whys[5]/whys[6] hand both to Yorick.
audit.why: The mirror set exactly these four rows to the packet sides. Leaving ours as-is renders the opposite answer to the same question on the paired page.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 -> Skill; rows 5, 6 -> Yorick, as matched full/content pairs with ratings inverted from the mirror's. Rows 0, 3 and 4 already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was built on a fabricated property: 'Stormbringer (R) makes him briefly untargetable'. whys[4] and content.mid repeat it.
audit.why: Riot's text for Stormbringer: he leaps to a location, slows and damages beneath him, gains bonus health, and disables nearby enemy towers. No untargetability anywhere. A player who believes he is untargetable will hold damage he should be using.
audit.corrected: All three fields now state the real spike — a 550-range leap on 160/135/110s that disables your tower — and the dive answer keyed to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions applicable here never reached the page: Dark Procession denying the Stormbringer landing, Thundering Smash being an auto-attack reset, and Frenzied Maul applying on-hit effects. The matching do/don't bodies held generic filler.
audit.why: Q is a 300-range reset stun on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. W is a 5s on-hit heal, so his damage scales with attack speed and armour alone misreads the trade. W (Dark Procession, 20/18/16/14/12s) creates a wall that blocks movement, which is what the dive needs.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d rewritten with those mechanics and their cooldowns.

edits.before: At 6 Stormbringer (R) gives an untargetable dive that beats your ghouls.
edits.after: At 6 Stormbringer leaps 550 range and disables your tower for a dive.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) makes him briefly untargetable, leaps a long range, and slows plus disables your tower; he can all-in or tower-dive you through your ghouls. Keep HP healthy, respect the dive threat with jungler, and don't get caught under his own tower when his R is up.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) leaps 550 range on a 160/135/110s cooldown, slows everyone beneath him, grants him bonus health and disables your tower — that is the dive. Keep your HP topped, ward for his jungler, and hold Dark Procession to wall the landing so the dive stalls.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 favour Volibear: his Q stun after chasing and Frenzied Maul sustain out-brawl you, and at 6 Stormbringer (R) gives him an untargetable dive that can all-in you or tower-dive through your ghouls. Keep your HP topped, ping your jungler for dive threat, and don't stand in his kill range when his R is up.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 favour Volibear: his Q stun after chasing and Frenzied Maul sustain out-brawl you, and at 6 Stormbringer (R) leaps 550 range and disables your tower, so he can all-in or dive straight through your ghouls. Keep your HP topped, ping your jungler for dive threat, and don't stand in his kill range when his R is up.

edits.before: His engage. Bait it before committing. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is 300 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — bait it, then go.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Dark Procession walls the Stormbringer landing — save the 20s cage for his R.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His Q is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s on-hit heal — Executioner's before armour.

notes: The 'untargetable Stormbringer' claim appeared in three separate fields and all three are corrected here. Packet header games (944) differs from the brief's games field (954) — worth a look at the packet builder, not something I could resolve from the brief.
